requirements.text: USE TODAY'S CAPACITY ('launch as many loops and subagents as possible to get more done'; 'you can run like 10 loops in one shot'): maximize concurrent build capacity now - the three codex loop lanes stay occupied and orchestrator-dispatched subagent producers and reviewers run in parallel, targeting about ten concurrent builders - with every unit still a contracted, claimed, gated ledger packet (the normal gated process is unchanged; capacity is added by running more disjoint packets at once, never by skipping a state or a gate).
requirements.required_harness: Contract seams binding each concurrently-run packet to this requirement via applicability.task_ids.
requirements.required_evidence: Ledger task files citing D-087-R001 + their G0 disjointness records + dispatch/launch evidence.
requirements.status_reason: Capacity ramps from the seq-128 capture seam.

requirements.text: NO INTERFERENCE ('of course not interfering with each other'; 'As long as they don't interfere with each other'): concurrent workers never share writable files - every concurrently-run packet's allowed_paths are pairwise disjoint from every other live or frozen packet (recorded at its G0), each writer works in its own isolated worktree, and a packet whose scope would overlap an in-flight one waits until that one is accepted.
requirements.required_harness: G0 pairwise-disjointness tables at every contract seam; worktree isolation per writer.
requirements.required_evidence: Each bound packet's G0 report + worktree/launcher records.
requirements.status_reason: Standing prohibition carried into every packet bound under R001.

requirements.text: 3D RELEASED ('you can even give them to build features that we pushed over later, like 3D. An amazing ... 3D handling on buildings and lap size'): the expansion section-2 hold (.claude/rules/expansion-agent-dispatch-hold.md) is RELEASED for 3D building-and-lot handling (reading 'lap size' as lot size): massing of the lot and of buildings (proposal draft, generated building option, existing context where sourced) built from the deterministic geometry contracts (canonical EPSG:2263 lot geometry server-side; display CRS only for rendering) and shown in the product - contracted as orchestrator-designed M<x>-T<n> packets under the normal gates. The July 3D/UI integration report and its pack are reference input only.
requirements.required_harness: Orchestrator-designed 3D packets bound here at their contract seams, each under full gates.
requirements.required_evidence: Ledger task files citing D-087-R003; accepted 3D increments with their gate records.

requirements.text: AUTOCAD IMPORT ('buildings being able to import into autocat. Through that special problem that we discussed forgot the name of it that basically is like the middleman'): the product exports the lot and building data (lot outline, building outline, floors/heights, massing) as a CAD interchange file that AutoCAD opens directly. Working reading of 'the middleman' = DXF (the Autodesk Drawing Exchange Format; AutoCAD opens it natively and can save it as DWG) - confirmation requested from the owner (R008).
requirements.required_harness: Offline tests on the exporter's output structure (layers, entities, units) + a documented AutoCAD-open check the owner can perform.
requirements.required_evidence: Ledger task files citing D-087-R004; the exporter module + its tests.
requirements.status_reason: Release effective at capture; format name awaiting owner confirmation (R008).

requirements.text: PDF BLUEPRINTS ('Writing blueprint, reading PDF Friday. I think we did that writing. But it can be probably improved'): phase C (assisted PDF drawing import, docs/PROPOSAL_EDITOR_PHASED_PLAN.md) is RELEASED - improve the existing in-repo PDF reading path (the strict-subset vector PDF reader under services/api/app/documents/extraction/, built for surveys) toward architect drawing sheets - and blueprint WRITING (drawing-sheet output of the lot + proposal) is released. The C-track honesty rules still bind: units/scale confirmed by the user against a known dimension; the user confirms which lines are building outline / property line / street frontage; discrepancies shown, never auto-reconciled; imported geometry enters the SAME proposal contract; supported drawing classes defined from REAL files (a fixture-corpus capture precedes the C1 reader widening).
requirements.required_harness: Offline reader tests on a real-file fixture corpus; C-track flow tests; the sheet writer's structural tests.
requirements.required_evidence: Ledger task files citing D-087-R005; the corpus capture record; accepted increments.
requirements.status_reason: Release effective at capture; the real-file corpus is the first dependency.

requirements.text: CAD FILES ('Writing editing exporting cat files dwgs all that stuff'): writing, editing and exporting CAD files is released as product work, through open interchange formats first (DXF out; the DXF/vector-PDF in-path per docs/SURVEY_DOCUMENT_FORMAT_POLICY.md) - native DWG stays behind R007.
requirements.required_harness: Offline structural tests per format; round-trip tests where both directions exist.
requirements.required_evidence: Ledger task files citing D-087-R006; accepted increments.

requirements.text: NATIVE DWG LIBRARY = OWNER DECISION ('dwgs'): native DWG read/write needs a proprietary licensed library (Autodesk RealDWG / Open Design Alliance) or a copyleft one (LibreDWG, GPL) - adopting any of them is a licensing/payment decision that stays STOPPED (Tier D / Section 20; the format policy's recorded STOP) until the owner rules. The question was put to the owner at capture; DXF (which AutoCAD saves as DWG) is the path meanwhile.
requirements.required_harness: No DWG library in any lockfile or import without a recorded owner decision.
requirements.required_evidence: Dependency lockfiles + the owner decision record when it arrives.

requirements.text: OWNER CONFIRMATION PENDING ('that special problem that we discussed forgot the name of it that basically is like the middleman'): the orchestrator's reading is DXF; confirmation was requested at capture. Work serving R004 proceeds on DXF meanwhile (it serves the AutoCAD-import goal under either reading; vector PDF is already the recorded INPUT interchange). A different answer is recorded as an amendment and re-scopes R004 without discarding delivered DXF work.
requirements.required_harness: Owner answer recorded as an amendment source.

requirements.text: UNCHANGED BOUNDARIES: every gate G0-G7, dependency security (any new package = the G5 provenance admission + exact pin + the 7-day age gate; zero-dependency implementations preferred), Tier D / Section 20, PR #241 (never merged), the unmounted max-envelope route and its mount preconditions, the D-086 sequencing and preservation prohibitions, the thin-client limits (no local npm, CI is the web authority), and D-051 fail-closed discipline all stand. The 19-task pack, its 9 contracts and GDS P1-P8 are not revived wholesale - features are built as orchestrator-designed packets that may cite them as reference input.
requirements.required_harness: Every bound packet's G0 + gates; dependency-security gates in CI.
requirements.required_evidence: Gate records and lockfile audits of the bound packets.

requirements.text: TIME WINDOW ('before today's reset'): the owner's usage window resets later today (2026-09-24, a Thursday; the recorded weekly reset is ~9 PM local per the D-036/D-055 history - unverified external fact). Capacity is front-loaded from the capture seam; nothing is rushed past a gate.
requirements.required_harness: Dispatch timestamps of the bound packets.
requirements.required_evidence: Launch/dispatch records at the capture-day seams.
